latestTerminalSummary:
Complete. All required scientific artifacts were saved before native Goal terminal completion (20:47 UTC, 48 min before the 21:35 deadline).

**Top finding:** the thin 6-clause plan is directionally sound but needs 3 corrections to be buildable — a terminal UNFILLED state (brief honesty requirement), atomic overlap prevention instead of warn-only detection, and a typed travel-estimate record even though estimation rules are out of Phase 1. Independent critique added 12 accepted findings, notably explicit offer-reservation semantics and a domain buy/configure alternative, all dispositioned in the final.

Artifacts in `jobs/B-05/treatment/research/`:
- [discovery.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/treatment/research/discovery.md) (25 KB, brief-only, frozen before reveal) + [source-map.json](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/treatment/research/source-map.json) (13 sources S01–S13) + `sources/` (14 files with index)
- [revealed-plan.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/treatment/research/revealed-plan.md) (P1–P6) via one-shot reveal gate; [draft.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/treatment/research/draft.md) (16 KB) with exact per-P dispositions
- Critic READY.json (SHA-verified, both hashes matched) → [final.md](/home/sittingmongoose/PM-Experiments/er11-20261009-116bb1e4/jobs/B-05/treatment/research/final.md) (28 KB): all 7 material + 5 minor findings accepted with evidence, 9 O1 candidates, 5 candidate architectures (all cost-gated), 7 user decisions, 10 uncertainties, executed E1–E5 vs proposed P-V0–P-V8 validations

Key evidence: Postgres exclusion + tstzrange + btree_gist (primary), Supabase grants+policies vs PocketBase locked-default rules (primary), OSRM seconds/meters units (primary v5.24.0), XState v4→v5 breaking chain (primary), Timefold fork lineage (primary, hygiene-fixed to JDK 21+), Cal.com 120/min + Platform freeze (primary). Secondary claims (CVE specifics, quotas, AGPL, pricing) explicitly marked NEEDS-PRIMARY. No runtime was available; no proposed check is presented as executed.
